# Fram

> A compact media workshop for your terminal and agent automation. Fram crops, resizes, compresses, and converts images; cuts, resizes, crops, compresses, changes FPS, strips audio, extracts frames, and makes GIFs from videos. A strict, scriptable CLI backed by a typed processing core, plus an interactive TUI.

Fram is a Python 3.11+ CLI built with Typer, using Pillow for images and FFmpeg for video. MIT licensed. Full expanded documentation for LLMs: https://fram.serhiifotex.dev/llms-full.txt

## Install

- Script: `curl -LsSf https://fram.serhiifotex.dev/install.sh | sh`
- Homebrew: `brew tap Sergio-prog/fram && brew install fram`
- uv: `uv tool install git+https://github.com/Sergio-prog/fram.git`
- Agent skill for AI coding agents: `npx skills add Sergio-prog/fram`
